title: NSF Overview
abstract: Faculty are invited to attend the NSF Workshop Sessions. Details of the sessions will be available as soon as the program is finalized. Each year NSF conducts these two Workshop Sessions at the Annual AIChE Meeting in order to provide useful information regarding the Foundation and its programs. Session 1 is focused on presentations relating to the NSF programs in the Division of Chemical, Bioengineering, Environmental and Transport Systems (CBET). The presentations will be made by program directors representing these clusters. There will be an opportunity to participate in a panel discussion on current trends in NSF funding. Session II includes a tutorial on proposal writing and round table discussions with individual program directors. We also invite faculty to visit the NSF Information Suite that will be open from from 8:00 a.m. until noon on Monday and from 8:00 a.m. until 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday and Wednesday. The NSF Information Suite provides an excellent opportunity for one-on-one discussions with NSF Program Officers.
